Here are **10 creative student project ideas** that combine a **Python API (backend)** with a **web UI (frontend)**. These projects are small enough for a student but showcase key skills like API integration, frontend development, and problem-solving.

---

### **1. Weather Dashboard with Forecast**
**API:** [OpenWeatherMap API](https://openweathermap.org/api)
**Tech Stack:** Python (Flask/FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS (or React/Vue)
**Features:**
- Fetch current weather and 5-day forecast for a city.
- Display temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather icons.
- Allow users to save favorite locations.
- Add a simple "weather alert" notification.

**Why?** Great for learning API calls, JSON parsing, and dynamic UI updates.

---

### **2. Movie/TV Show Explorer**
**API:** [TMDB API](https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api)
**Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS (or Svelte)
**Features:**
- Search for movies/TV shows by title.
- Display posters, ratings, release dates, and synopses.
- Show trending/popular movies.
- Allow users to create a "watchlist" (stored in localStorage or a simple DB).

**Why?** Fun, visually appealing, and teaches API pagination and filtering.

---

### **3. Random Quote Generator with Sharing**
**API:** [Quotable API](https://github.com/lukePeavey/quotable) or [ZenQuotes](https://zenquotes.io/)
**Tech Stack:** Python (Flask), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Fetch random quotes (by author, tag, or random).
- Display quote with author and tags.
- Add a "Tweet this" button (using Twitter’s Web Intent API).
- Allow users to save favorite quotes.

**Why?** Simple but teaches API caching, UI animations, and social sharing.

---

### **4. Currency Converter with Historical Data**
**API:** [ExchangeRate-API](https://www.exchangerate-api.com/) or [Fixer.io](https://fixer.io/)
**Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Convert between currencies (USD, EUR, JPY, etc.).
- Show historical exchange rates (e.g., USD to EUR over the last 30 days).
- Add a "favorites" feature for quick access.
- Dark/light mode toggle.

**Why?** Teaches API rate limits, data visualization (charts), and responsive design.

---

### **5. GitHub Profile Analyzer**
**API:** [GitHub REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest)
**Tech Stack:** Python (Flask), HTML/CSS/JS (or React)
**Features:**
- Enter a GitHub username to fetch profile stats (repos, followers, stars, etc.).
- Display a bar chart of most-used languages (using Chart.js).
- Show recent activity (commits, PRs).
- Compare two users side-by-side.

**Why?** Great for learning OAuth (if you add GitHub login) and data visualization.

---

### **6. NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) Viewer**
**API:** [NASA APOD API](https://api.nasa.gov/)
**Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Fetch NASA’s "Astronomy Picture of the Day" with explanation.
- Allow users to browse past APODs by date.
- Add a "favorites" gallery.
- Full-screen mode for images.

**Why?** Unique, visually stunning, and teaches date handling in APIs.

---

### **7. Joke Generator with Categories**
**API:** [JokeAPI](https://v2.jokeapi.dev/) or [Official Joke API](https://github.com/15Dkatz/official_joke_api)
**Tech Stack:** Python (Flask), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Fetch random jokes (programming, dark humor, pun, etc.).
- Filter jokes by category.
- Add a "like/dislike" system (stored in localStorage).
- Share jokes via Twitter or copy to clipboard.

**Why?** Lighthearted, teaches API filtering and user feedback.

---

### **8. Stock Market Tracker (Simplified)**
**API:** [Alpha Vantage](https://www.alphavantage.co/) or [Yahoo Finance API](https://www.yahoofinanceapi.com/)
**Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Search for stock symbols (e.g., AAPL, TSLA).
- Display current price, daily change, and 7-day trend (line chart).
- Add a "watchlist" for favorite stocks.
- Show news related to the stock (using a news API).

**Why?** Introduces financial data APIs and real-time updates.

---

### **9. Recipe Finder with Ingredients**
**API:** [Edamam Recipe API](https://developer.edamam.com/edamam-recipe-api) or [Spoonacular](https://spoonacular.com/food-api)
**Tech Stack:** Python (Flask), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Search recipes by ingredients (e.g., "chicken, rice, tomatoes").
- Display recipe details (ingredients, instructions, image).
- Filter by diet (vegan, gluten-free, etc.).
- Save favorite recipes.

**Why?** Practical, teaches API query parameters and user input handling.

---

### **10. COVID-19 Tracker (or Any Global Stats)**
**API:** [COVID-19 API](https://covid19api.com/) or [Disease.sh](https://disease.sh/)
**Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI), HTML/CSS/JS
**Features:**
- Display global COVID-19 stats (cases, deaths, recoveries).
- Show country-wise data in a table or map (using Leaflet.js).
- Add a "trends" chart (cases over time).
- Compare two countries.

**Why?** Teaches data aggregation, maps, and real-world API usage.

---

### **Bonus Tips for All Projects:**
1. **Use a Framework:** For the backend, use **Flask** (simpler) or **FastAPI** (more modern). For the frontend, start with **HTML/CSS/JS** or try **React/Vue/Svelte** if you want a challenge.
2. **Add a Database:** Store user data (e.g., favorites) using **SQLite** (simple) or **Firebase** (no backend needed).
3. **Deploy It:** Use **Render**, **Railway**, or **Vercel** to host your project for free.
4. **Error Handling:** Add loading states, error messages, and input validation.
5. **UI Polish:** Use **Bootstrap** or **TailwindCSS** for quick styling.

Would you like me to expand on any of these ideas with a **starter code template**? 🚀
